metadata.task_category: Data Structures - Range Queries / Sliding Window

prompt_text: Write an efficient Python solution for the HackerRank problem Almost Equal - Advanced.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution works only for a single array but ignores the requirement of handling multiple range queries [l, r].
bug_analysis.root_cause: Incorrect problem interpretation by treating it as a single global problem instead of per-query computation.
